entries.EN: Neither a saint, nor a scoundrel. The Barkeep knows his worth and is respected by all stalkers. Rumor has it he is hiding in the Zone from some dark events in his past. After an encounter with an anomaly, his never healed right and his limp forced him to change careers. He set up a bar at the Duty base, and the place gradually turned into the favorite watering hole and meeting spot for all of the Zone's veterans. The Barkeep has since acquired numerous connections both in the Zone and in the outside world, and has began to run smuggling operations across the border of the Zone. Supplies come in, Artifacts and mutant parts go out.

entries.EN: Formerly a mechanic at the "KholodMach" plant. After his wife left him, he decided to take his own life. However, being deeply religious, he could not carry out the act himself, so he hoped the Zone would do it for him. Contrary to his expectations, he survived all that the Zone threw at him. He has gained invaluable experience and has won the respect of other stalkers thanks to his driven attitude and solid decision making skills. Master is probably the most qualified mechanic in the Zone, and is capable at repairing all manner of equipment and even heavy vehicles. Lately has taken to installing security systems for the various armed faction of the Zone in exchange for decent pay. His neutrality makes him welcome everywhere he goes. A simple, stern man, a bit rough around the edges when provoked.

The only soldier to return from a disastrous operation deep in the Zone, later discovered that the mission was utterly pointless and downright suicidal due to poor planning by the higher-ups. Quiet, cynical, firm of purpose and disciplined.

entries.EN: Klutz is 20 years old, a child compared to many of the guys in the Zone. He lost everything and everyone in the Big Land before deciding to try his here. He can barely manage to make a living, yet he simply has no other place to go to. For this reason, he owes money to many stalkers and often continues to borrow more just to buy food and water. Travels the Zone in search of opportunities but never goes alone, instead he usually tags along with groups of experienced Stalkers. Not a popular companion amongst the loners, because more often than not, he's plain useless and contributes little.

entries.EN: Sparrow is 27 years old, cunning, and farseeing, but also capable of the worst blunders. Can be mean. A rather dubious persona. A scrawny and pallid type. Came to the Zone out of curiosity, promising himself he would return home after a couple of months. He never did. On his very first sally into the Zone, Sparrow managed to cross an infamous field strewn with deadly anomalies barehanded, no protective gear or detector, and was apparently completely oblivious about what he managed to do and just how dangerous it was. When someone told him how close he came to having every bone in his body turned into splinters, he passed out. Since then, celebrates that date (October 9th) as his second birthday.
